sources.entry: RSSHub - Easy to use, and extensible RSS feed aggregator capable of generating RSS feeds from pretty much everything ranging from social media to university departments. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Nodejs/Docker
RSSHub | Generate RSS feeds from almost any website

summary.one_liner: RSSHub is an open-source feed generator that produces RSS feeds for websites and services that don't offer them, from social media to university department pages.
summary.what_it_does: RSSHub generates RSS feeds from many kinds of sources, including social media and institutional sites, through a collection of routes. The README describes it as the world's largest RSS network, with over 5,000 global instances. It is extensible, and an open community adds new routes, features and bug fixes. Documentation covers Quick Start, contribution, and deployment. The README points to related projects: Folo (an AI RSS reader), RSSHub Radar (a browser extension for discovering feeds), RSSBud (iOS), RSSAid (Android), a Raycast DocSearch integration, and an Awesome RSSHub Routes list. The README does not include install commands, so setup details must be taken from the linked documentation.
use_cases: generate an RSS feed from a site that has none
follow social media accounts in an RSS reader
discover feeds for websites with a browser extension
aggregate content from many sources into one reader
how_to_run: Refer to Quick Start in the RSSHub documentation
Refer to Deployment in the RSSHub documentation
notable: Route-based feed generation for almost any website or social platform
Large public network of over 5,000 global instances
Ecosystem of related tools: Folo reader, RSSHub Radar browser extension, mobile companions
Open source with an active community contributing new routes
caveats: The README gives no install commands; setup is delegated to external documentation
Feed availability depends on individual routes that the community maintains
Some listings describe it as a demo or public hosted service, which may differ from self-hosting
